feedback: The kp 2.5 test you proposed has already raced as iteration 7 (entityR2B, 79.60), so this iteration's rationale is out of date. On wheel_track 0.10 with kp 2.5, slalom line loss was 0.0, which meets your target, but oval progress was 0.30 and max_error stayed at 0.062 to 0.063 m. That meets your own revert condition (oval progress below 0.35). Iteration 6 (kp 3.0, wheel_track 0.10) gave slalom line loss 0.35 and oval progress 0.28, so the narrow track has not produced better tracking at any gain tried. The best measured score on the 0.12 track with mass 0.8 and body_length 0.18 is iteration 5 (111.80, oval progress 0.55, slalom line loss 0.10). For the next geometry, I recommend returning wheel_track to 0.12 with the rest of the iteration-5 platform unchanged, since max_error has stayed at 0.061 to 0.066 m across every geometry tried. The current candidate has not raced, so I state no outcome for it.
requested_changes: Revert wheel_track to 0.12, keeping mass 0.8, body_length 0.18, sensors at y 0.03 with 16 mm footprints. Iteration 5 on this platform scored 111.80 with slalom line loss 0.10.
If you keep wheel_track 0.10, do not repeat the kp 2.5 test. Use kp 2.75 (the current controller) and treat the kp 2.5 result (iteration 7) as the baseline for it.
Do not reduce inertia further (mass or body_length) on the slalom track. Iteration 4 showed slalom line loss of 0.85 at mass 0.7 and body_length 0.14.
